description: This file defines constants, data structures, and functions for managing I3C device addresses, including address status enumeration, address slots structure, and functions to initialize, set, check, and find free addresses on the I3C bus.

methods.name: i3c_addr_slots_init
methods.description: Initializes the I3C address slots structure, clearing address bits and setting reserved bits according to the I3C specification.

methods.name: i3c_addr_slots_set
methods.description: Sets the address status for a given device address in the address slots structure.

methods.name: i3c_addr_slots_status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a specific device address.

methods.name: i3c_addr_slots_is_free
methods.description: Checks if a specific device address is free.

methods.name: i3c_addr_slots_next_free_find
methods.description: Finds the next free device address starting from a specified address.
